== Biography ==

Billina is a yellow hen with fluffy feathers and a pearl necklace around her throat, seen perched on the shoulder of the copper man Tik-tok. When Dorothy catches sight of her, she cries out in a glad voice and the hen flies to her arms, where Dorothy hugs and pets her in turn. Dorothy sits down in the road with Billina in her arms and strokes her back while the copper man offers his monotonous welcome to Oz. Billina tells Dorothy she has "some wonderful news" to share with her.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — friend. Dorothy calls Billina "one of my dearest friends," who "mustn't be hurt—now or ever," indicating a close bond between them.

'''[[Ozma]]''' — Billina's tie to Ozma seems to be one of service: she reports being sent, together with Tik-tok, "to wel-come" Dorothy on Ozma's behalf.

'''[[Tik-tok]]''' — friend. A reference to Tik-tok having saved "my life—and Billina's life, too" suggests a bond of loyalty between them.

'''[[Toto]]''' — some tension between Billina and Toto is suggested, though no specific incident is described.
